summary.note_on_rejected_inserts: when quadtree_insert rejects a point (returns 0, nothing stored) the C leaves the key with the caller and calls no key_free; the translation takes the key by value (Option<Box<dyn Any>>) and drops it. No C-visible channel shows this; it is the Rust ownership signature, not a key_free call.
